# Thurlby Apiary - honey room labels

Extraction logs land in sheets/ as rows:

    <hive> / <frames> / <grade>

Only grade A batches go to the labelled jars; grade B stays in the
farm-gate bucket and is never labelled. Label lists are written
into labels/ under the extraction date, one file named
YYYY-MM-DD.txt, one line per batch in log order:

    - <hive> - <frames> frames
